t: Git Without a Server: Using Your Local Filesystem as a Remote
s: This article explains how to use Git's full versioning capabilities without remote servers by leveraging a local 'bare' repository on the filesystem. It details setup, synchronization, and the benefits of this private, offline workflow.
sub: Setting up a local bare Git repository.
Cloning and synchronizing with a local bare repository.
Benefits of local-only Git workflows (privacy, speed, learning).
Understanding Git's local file protocol for remote operations.
